heading: INT. BOWLING ALLEY - LANE 9 - ARBITRATION HEARING - DAY

units.text: INT. BOWLING ALLEY - LANE 9 - ARBITRATION HEARING - DAY
A defunct bowling alley, repurposed.
Folding tables over the gutters.
A pin-setting machine looms behind the panel like a sleeping beast.
ARBITRATOR HELENA MBEKI, sixties, reading glasses on a chain, presides from the scoring desk.
At the left table: attorney SUNITA KAPOOR, forties, crisp navy suit.
At the right: attorney CONRAD ASHWORTH, fifties, rumpled tweed.
In the witness chair, a plastic bowling seat: DMITRI VOLKOV, sixties, retired foreman, hands folded.
At a small side table, court reporter PAULINA ZAJAC, twenties, fingers poised.
Quiet.
Pins rattle faintly somewhere behind a wall.
We are on the record. Mr. Volkov, you've been sworn.
units.name: HELENA

units.text: I have.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Mr. Volkov, thank you for coming. I'd like to ask about the night of the fourteenth.
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: Of course.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: You were foreman on the closing shift at the Calloway plant?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: Twenty-two years.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: And that night, you signed the safety log?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: I did. As I always did.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Was the lockout valve on press four engaged?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: It was.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Objection. Leading.
units.name: CONRAD

units.text: Overruled, Mr. Ashworth. She is asking for a fact.
units.name: HELENA

units.text: Then I'll hold my fire, Madam Arbitrator.
units.name: CONRAD

units.text: Mr. Volkov. Was the valve engaged?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: Yes.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: You're certain.
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: I checked it with my own hand.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: And yet the incident report states that press four cycled at eleven forty.
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: It did.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: How is that possible if the valve was engaged?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: Because I disengaged it at eleven thirty-five.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Could the witness repeat that?
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: I disengaged it at eleven thirty-five.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Madam Arbitrator, may we have a moment?
units.name: CONRAD

units.text: No. Mr. Volkov, why would you do that?
units.name: HELENA

units.text: Because Mr. Calloway's son told me to. He said the order was behind. He said nobody would be near it.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Was anyone near it?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: My nephew. Nikolai. He was cleaning the die.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Ms. Kapoor, do you have further questions?
units.name: HELENA

units.text: Only one. Mr. Volkov, why did you sign the log?
units.name: SUNITA

units.text: Because they said they would pay for his hospital. And I did not know how to say no.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: I withdraw my objection. And I withdraw my client's motion.
units.name: CONRAD

units.text: Mr. Ashworth?
units.name: HELENA

units.text: My client wishes to settle.
units.name: CONRAD

units.text: Ms. Zajac, strike nothing.
units.name: HELENA

units.text: Yes, ma'am.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: We are adjourned.
units.name: HELENA
